font_faces_weights.name: font_faces_weights
font_faces_weights.value: ("font_faces"."weight_min" is null and "font_faces"."weight_max" is null) or ("font_faces"."weight_min" <= "font_faces"."weight" and "font_faces"."weight" <= "font_faces"."weight_max" and "font_faces"."weight_min" < "font_faces"."weight_max")

font_faces_scope.name: font_faces_scope
font_faces_scope.value: ("font_faces"."source" = 'google' and "font_faces"."workspace_id" is null and "font_faces"."brand_id" is null) or ("font_faces"."source" = 'upload' and "font_faces"."workspace_id" is not null and "font_faces"."brand_id" is not null)
